verdict.rationale: Jules can be assigned tasks (via label or API), clone/build a repo, produce diffs and open PRs, and its API explicitly supports automating 'bug fixing' workflows embedded into tools like GitHub — but there is no evidence of a built-in trigger that detects failed CI workflows and automatically dispatches a diagnostic/fix task. Missing for 10: documented CI-failure detection/trigger (e.g. GitHub Actions webhook integration), explicit 'CI diagnosis' workflow examples, and independent confirmation of this exact use case.
